title: Financial Markets Conduct Act 2013, Part 7A (climate-related disclosures for certain FMC reporting entities with higher level of public accountability)
citation: Financial Markets Conduct Act 2013 (2013 No 69) Part 7A, inserted by section 8 of the Financial Sector (Climate-related Disclosures and Other Matters) Amendment Act 2021 (2021 No 39)
evidence: Part 7A history note on the point-in-time version as at 27 October 2022 (https://www.legislation.govt.nz/act/public/2013/69/en/2022-10-27/, opened 2026-11-02): "Part 7A: inserted, on 27 October 2022, by section 8 of the Financial Sector (Climate-related Disclosures and Other Matters) Amendment Act 2021 (2021 No 39)." No earlier version of the Act contains Part 7A.
notes: Records hold Part 7A only (not the whole Act), one per version where the Part text differs: 2022-10-27 and 2024-10-27. Part 7A is in 13 of the Act's 38 dated versions and has two distinct texts across them. The page numbers the sections 461N to 461ZK in the headings read; the brief said 461O to 461ZQ. The register row cites an FMA page; the FMA site (Cloudflare challenge, 403 from the cloud address) was not opened. Reporting periods start on or after 2023-01-01 (see the XRB standards).
